text: If you run a lot in Texas and your deals still go to the county on a prayer, give me ninety seconds.

The county doesn't return a deal because you're bad at this. It returns it because one line on one form didn't agree with another.
So I built Apohenia. Deal Packet Checker reads the deal jacket against what webDEALER wants right now, and hands your clerk a short list before anything leaves the building.
It doesn't file for you. It doesn't promise approvals. It reports what it finds, by how often it shows up, and a human decides.
We're running it on our own lot first. A few Texas pilot places are open for stores under thirty deals a month.
